Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 05 September 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales, Bataan, Tarlac(San Jose, Capas, Bamban) and Pampanga(Porac, Floridablanca).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Nueva Ecija and Bulacan within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Batangas, Laguna, Metro Manila, Cavite, Rizal, Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Camiling, Mayantoc, Moncada, San Clemente, Santa Ignacia), Pampanga(Lubao, Sasmuan, Apalit, Arayat, Bacolor, Candaba, San Fernando, Macabebe, Magalang, Masantol, Mexico, Minalin, San Luis, San Simon, Santa Ana, Santo Tomas, Angeles, Mabalacat, Guagua, Santa Rita) and Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Real, Mauban, Sampaloc, Tayabas, Lucban, Sariaya, Dolores, Tiaong, San Antonio, Candelaria) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
